name: granttap
description: Pair local coding agents with GrantTap and approve, answer, or steer their work from iPhone and Apple Watch.

interface.shortDescription: Control coding agents from iPhone and Apple Watch.
interface.longDescription: Authorize Codex to access the local GrantTap MCP service. The sign-in page displays a one-time QR when this computer needs iPhone pairing; an already paired computer can be authorized without changing its keys. A confirmed reconnect can show a new QR. Then approve requests, answer questions, and continue local coding-agent tasks from iPhone or Apple Watch. No GrantTap account or password is required; provider sign-in is separate.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this computer is connected to GrantTap.
